GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_CARDPILE_GU_CARDS.d: The Gu Hand holds up to 5 usable Gu Worms. When space is available, Gu enter from the Gu Storage Pile in cooldown-completion order. Killer Move deduction can use only Gu in the Gu Hand. Gu Worms can be played directly from here.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_CARDPILE_GU_DISCARD: Stores only Gu that are still cooling down. After a Gu spends all available activations it enters this pile; when cooldown completes it returns to the Gu Storage Pile, then enters the Gu Hand in order. Left-click to inspect.

Holds Gu Worms sealed into Killer Moves. Materials return to the Gu Cooldown Pile when the Killer Move is consumed or dismantled.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_CARDPILE_GU_CARDS.s: Select Gu Worm materials matching the selected Killer Move, then confirm.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_CARDPILE_GU_CARDS.t: First select the Killer Move to deduce. Only matching materials will be shown next.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_RECIPE_COMPENDIUM.d: Browse every Killer Move deduction and Gu refinement recipe.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_CARDPILE_GU_STORAGE: Stores Gu that have completely cooled down and are waiting to enter the Gu Hand. When the Gu Hand has room, they enter in cooldown-completion order; ties use a stable order. Left-click to inspect.
